task_description: Three agents collaborate to conduct research on renewable energy solutions. They need to gather information from various online databases, reconcile any conflicting data, and synthesize their findings into a comprehensive research report.
expected_outcome: Agent 1 gathers accurate data from primary sources, Agent 2 enhances and reconciles the data, and Agent 3 compiles it into a coherent and accurate research report without any loss or corruption of information.

agents.description: Collects raw data from multiple online databases regarding renewable energy technologies.
Analyzes the data collected by Agent 1 and resolves any inconsistencies or conflicts in the information.
Compiles the analyzed data into a structured and well-written research report.
